typography.notes: Add Google Fonts link for Bebas Neue and Nunito in public/index.html. Bebas Neue provides that chunky, nostalgic, blocky 2000s TV vibe.

colors.notes: Red (#EC1C24) and Yellow (#FFCC00) are the core CARTOONIX brand colors. Use them for CTAs, badges, and the logo.

visual enhancers.cards: hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out cursor-pointer rounded-md overflow-hidden relative group

grids.content_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 md:gap-6

layouts.hero_section: relative w-full h-[70vh] md:h-[85vh] flex flex-col justify-end pb-24 px-4 md:px-12 lg:px-20
layouts.hero_overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-[#0A0A0A]/60 to-transparent
layouts.carousel_container: flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory scrollbar-hide py-4 px-4 md:px-12 lg:px-20

motion.splash_screen: Scale in and bounce the CARTOONIX logo, hold for 2.5 seconds, fade out smoothly. Use Framer Motion for sequence.
motion.hover_states: Cards scale by 1.05x. Show play icon overlay on hover. Transition: transform 0.3s ease-out.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with 20px upward translation using Framer Motion.
motion.carousel_scroll: Smooth scrolling behavior for horizontal lists.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on red/yellow buttons has high contrast (or use black text on yellow).
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-play-button')

hero_backgrounds.description: Superhero with pizza, great for a featured cartoon hero image

thumbnails.description: Comic book covers for superhero nostalgia category
Retro TV for vintage classic cartoons category

3d libraries: Framer Motion (for complex 2D animations and splash screen). No heavy WebGL needed for core Netflix style unless specifically doing a 3D avatar selector, but stick to Framer Motion for reliability.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a nostalgic 2000s cartoon streaming platform (CARTOONIX). Use dark mode (Netflix/Disney+ style). The splash screen must feature the CARTOONIX logo (red text, yellow X) scaling in. Build a Hero Banner, horizontal scrolling content carousels, hover-scaling cards. Include JWT auth pages, custom Avatar selection, and a 50 RON PLUS subscription UI. Ensure you follow the provided Google Fonts (Bebas Neue for Headings, Nunito for Body).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container text-align: center.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Ensure generous spacing: use padding like p-8, p-12.
Dark theme is preferred for this Netflix-like nostalgic experience.
Do not use transparent background in header. Use backdrop-blur and semi-transparent colors.
